summary: The same every-minute catalogue sync, fetching only products changed since a saved cursor and upserting only rows whose values differ.

must_not_flag.reason: The upsert's WHERE skips rows whose values are unchanged, and the run only receives products the supplier changed since the saved cursor; an unchanged catalogue costs one indexed read per minute.

must_not_flag.contains: "INSERT INTO sync_state (name, cursor) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET cursor = excluded.cursor"
must_not_flag.reason: The cursor is written after the batch succeeds, under the same name the next run reads, so each run starts where the last one ended.
